description: Fibre Recovery Zones is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Forest Tenures Branch. The Fibre Recovery Zones (FRZ) define areas where increased waste rates may apply to avoidable waste left on a cutting authority as detailed in the Provincial Logging Residue and Waste Measurement Procedure Manual. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Forest Tenures Branch. Its tags are FRZ, Fibre Recovery, Providers, Waste Assessment. It offers 3 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, WMS. The portal shows 2025-08-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
